lines.text: He preserves our lives
and keeps our feet from slipping.
For You, O God, have tested us;
You have refined us like silver.
You led us into the net;
You laid burdens on our backs.
You let men ride over our heads;
we went through fire and water,
but You brought us into abundance.
I will enter Your house with burnt offerings;
I will fulfill my vows to You—
the vows that my lips promised
and my mouth spoke in my distress.
I will offer You fatlings as burnt offerings,
with the fragrant smoke of rams;
I will offer bulls and goats.
Selah
Come and listen, all you who fear God,
and I will declare what He has done for me.
I cried out to Him with my mouth
and praised Him with my tongue.
If I had cherished iniquity in my heart,
the Lord would not have listened.
But God has surely heard;
He has attended to the sound of my prayer.
Blessed be God, who has not rejected my prayer
or withheld from me His loving devotion!

pictures.scene: Emanuel de Witte, Interior of a Protestant Gothic Church — the organ hanging high on the pillar above the few people in the aisle, let the sound of His praise be heard, He preserves our lives
pictures.name: pd_de_witte_church_interior_with_organ

pictures.scene: Caspar David Friedrich, Wanderer above the Sea of Fog — the man standing firm on the rock above the drop and the cloud, and keeps our feet from slipping, for You O God have tested us
pictures.name: pd_friedrich_wanderer_above_the_sea_of_fog

pictures.scene: Joseph Wright of Derby, An Iron Forge — the white-hot bar on the anvil lighting the whole shed, You have refined us like silver, You led us into the net
pictures.name: pd_wright_an_iron_forge

pictures.scene: Ilya Repin, Barge Haulers on the Volga — the men harnessed in a line dragging the barge up the sand, You laid burdens on our backs, You let men ride over our heads
pictures.name: pd_repin_barge_haulers_on_the_volga

pictures.scene: J. M. W. Turner, The Burning of the Houses of Lords and Commons — the fire going up off the water in one sheet of light, we went through fire and water, but You brought us into abundance
pictures.name: pd_turner_burning_of_the_houses_of_parliament

pictures.scene: Rembrandt, Simeon's Song of Praise — the old man kneeling in the temple with the child in his arms and his face lifted, I will enter Your house with burnt offerings, I will fulfill my vows to You
pictures.name: pd_rembrandt_simeons_song_of_praise

pictures.scene: Rembrandt, Jeremiah Lamenting the Destruction of Jerusalem — the prophet sitting alone with his head on his hand and the city burning behind him, the vows that my lips promised and my mouth spoke in my distress
pictures.name: pd_rembrandt_jeremiah_lamenting

pictures.scene: Anton Mauve, The Return of the Flock — the whole flock driven home over the heath with the shepherd behind them, I will offer You fatlings as burnt offerings, with the fragrant smoke of rams
pictures.name: pd_mauve_the_return_of_the_flock

pictures.scene: Rosa Bonheur, Ploughing in the Nivernais — the teams of oxen leaning into the yoke and turning the field, I will offer bulls and goats, Selah
pictures.name: pd_bonheur_ploughing_in_the_nivernais

pictures.scene: Pieter Bruegel the Elder, The Sermon of Saint John the Baptist — the crowd packed under the trees and climbing them to hear the preacher, come and listen all you who fear God, and I will declare what He has done for me
pictures.name: pd_bruegel_sermon_of_john_the_baptist

pictures.scene: Gerard van Honthorst, King David Playing the Harp — the king at his harp with his mouth open and his eyes turned up, I cried out to Him with my mouth and praised Him with my tongue
pictures.name: pd_honthorst_king_david_playing_the_harp

pictures.scene: Rembrandt, Judas Returning the Thirty Pieces of Silver — the man on his knees with his hands wrung together and the priest turning away from him, if I had cherished iniquity in my heart the Lord would not have listened
pictures.name: pd_rembrandt_judas_returning_the_thirty_pieces_of_silver

pictures.scene: Jean-François Millet, The Angelus — the woman standing in the field with her hands folded and her head bowed at the bell, but God has surely heard, He has attended to the sound of my prayer
pictures.name: pd_millet_the_angelus

pictures.scene: Rembrandt, The Return of the Prodigal Son — the father's hands laid on the back of the son knelt against him, blessed be God who has not rejected my prayer or withheld from me His loving devotion
pictures.name: pd_rembrandt_return_of_the_prodigal_son
